ai_summary: Aartech Solonics Limited reported a robust Q1 FY27, with revenue growing approximately one and a half times year-on-year to 728 lakhs and Profit Before Tax increasing significantly to 119 lakhs, driven by strong order execution and disciplined expense management. The company maintains a healthy, debt-free balance sheet and is expanding into new segments like advanced energy storage, defense, and higher-voltage control panels, supported by an existing order book of T10-T15 crore and T100 crore in inquiries. A potential material impact is the acknowledged long gestation period for converting significant inquiries into confirmed orders, which could delay revenue realization, alongside management noting that the stock price has not yet fully reflected the improved performance.
